# Drishti Medical Store (दृष्टि मेडिकल स्टोर) — DMS

> Open, machine-readable ophthalmic medicine catalogue and counter availability enquiry portal at https://dms.piecs.org/

Drishti Medical Store (DMS) is an **eye-only ophthalmic medical store** physically located inside **Sant Kabir Eye Hospital, Bansi Road, Near Pindari Hospital, Katra, Basti, Moor Ghat, Uttar Pradesh – 272001, India** ([santkabireyehospital.piecs.org](https://santkabireyehospital.piecs.org/) | Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/5BYvRvsRoLVSubBW9 | OPD Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Campus Hospital Inquiry: +91-9336466677).

- **Catalogue Size:** 4,291 indexed ophthalmic formulations, eye drops, gels, ointments, and surgical eye-care supplies (dynamically built from our verified dataset).
- **Main Categories:** Antibiotic Eye Care (1977), Lubricants & Artificial Tears (792), Glaucoma & Eye Pressure (413), Anti-Allergic Eye Drops (356), Ophthalmic NSAIDs (270), Anti-Inflammatory & Steroids (206), Mydriatic & Cycloplegic (100), Ophthalmic Formulations (71).
- **Availability Semantics (`availability_status`):** All records currently report `"contact_store"` — appearing in our reference catalogue does NOT claim guaranteed immediate physical stock. Staff confirm live shelf availability and selling price (INR) by phone callback before pickup.
- **Pricing Policy:** Selling prices are omitted (`price: null`, `currency: "INR"`, `price_status: "confirm_with_store"`) rather than invented or estimated.

## Public Discovery URLs & Read-Only Catalogue API (No Auth Required)

- **Medicine Detail Pages:** `https://dms.piecs.org/medicine/{medicine-slug}` (crawlable static HTML with Schema.org `Product` & `BreadcrumbList` JSON-LD, e.g. `/medicine/moxicip-eye-drop`, `/medicine/refresh-tears-eye-drop`)
- **Browseable HTML Directory:** `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines` (paginated directory + category hubs)
- **Full Sitemap:** `https://dms.piecs.org/sitemap.xml` (every public medicine URL)
- **Paginated Catalogue API:** `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/catalog?page=1&limit=50`
- **Full Catalogue JSON Export:** `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/catalog.json`
- **Single Medicine Lookup:** `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/medicine/{id-or-slug}`
- **Search API (Brand / Generic / Composition / Manufacturer / Typos / Hindi):** `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/search?q={query}`
- **Extended AI Agent Documentation:** `https://dms.piecs.org/llms-full.txt`

## Enquiry & Prescription Policy

- **Enquiry-Only Counter Pickup (No Online Orders or Delivery):** Patients check items via `https://dms.piecs.org/#enquiry` or follow `enquiry_url` from any medicine record (`POST /api/enquiry`), after which store staff call back to confirm live stock and INR price.
- **Prescription Policy:** We do NOT prescribe medicine or provide medical advice. Prescription ophthalmic medicines require an original valid written prescription from a licensed doctor or ophthalmologist at physical pickup.
